editorial:
Ever feel like the universe is trying to tell you something? You will relate to that feeling while watching these three strangers who start noticing weird patterns in their normal days. Everything from a random sound to a strange look from a passerby starts feeling like a secret message. It starts out as a curious mystery, but as they follow these signs, they stop caring about their friends and family. You get to see how an obsession can pull a person away from reality and make them feel like they are the only ones who know the truth.

The acting is solid and makes the slow build-up feel real. While the pacing is a bit slow at times, the payoff is worth the wait. If you like stories that mess with your head, you will love this. It is best to watch this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you can rent it on Apple TV if you want a quick movie night. If you are a big collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move to keep the quality high.
endingExplained: You find out that the strange feelings were actually a way for the characters to connect across different points in time. The twist shows that their lives were looping and overlapping. In the final scenes, the strangers finally meet, realizing they were always meant to find each other. It wraps up by showing that the patterns were not random, but a bridge that brought them together despite the distance and time between them.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves puzzles and mysteries about fate.
